capabilities: Generate kanban columns automatically from any base property
Drag cards between columns to update property values
Group the board into swimlanes using a second property
Quick-add notes from a column's + button with column and lane values pre-filled
Customize card titles, cover images, column colors and column order
disambiguation: Not a standalone kanban board plugin; it only works as a custom view inside an Obsidian Base.
extras: Forked with a unique plugin ID (kanban-bases-view-cl) and view type (kanban-view-cl) so it can coexist with other kanban Bases plugins; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Christian Lempa's customized edition of Kanban Bases View
motivation: Inspired by the need for better task management in Obsidian Bases.
problem: Obsidian Bases has no board layout, so notes grouped by a property can only be seen as lists or cards, not moved between columns.

relations.evidence: This is Christian Lempa's customized edition of Kanban Bases View
Built with SortableJS for drag-and-drop functionality

summary: Kanban-style drag-and-drop custom view for Obsidian Bases that groups notes into columns by any property, with swimlanes and quick-add cards.
